title: FEWS NET cross-border trade (XBT), Kenya — national context layer
source: FEWS NET East Africa Cross-Border Trade (XBT) monitoring
method: Deterministic pass-through (_sources/parse_xbt.py): keeps Kenya-touching flows only (destination=Kenya -> Import, source=Kenya -> Export; transit/non-Kenya dropped). No LLM/transcription — the numeric qty is the banked value verbatim. partner_iso3 is a fixed reference code map (country ISO3, not data) so the notebook joins partners to the admin0 topojson and places flow arrows at d3.geoCentroid positions — no coordinates are typed by hand.
resolution: NATIONAL / border-point — NOT county. A country-level supply/trade context layer for Block 4, identical for every county selection.
grain: one row per partner x direction x trade_type x product x month

columns.partner: the non-Kenya country in the flow
columns.border_point: Kenyan crossing the flow was observed at (Moyale, Malaba, Namanga, ...)
columns.qty: quantity in qty_unit (banked value, not derived)

coverage: 24272 Kenya-touching rows, 2010-2024, 99 products, partners Ethiopia/Uganda/Tanzania/Somalia/South Sudan/Sudan/Rwanda/Malawi/Zambia/DRC/Congo. Imports dominate (Kenya is a maize-deficit importer; ASAL livestock trade is cross-border).
used_by: notebook.qmd Block 4 (national-context trade-flow map + imports-by-partner chart)
